test_concat_dataframe_basic: test the concat function to append two DataFrames and verify column alignment with partial columns
test_concat_empty_dataframe: test the concat function with an empty DataFrame and verify the result equals the non-empty input
test_concat_verify_integrity: test that concat raises ValueError when verify_integrity=True and indexes overlap
test_concat_series_to_dataframe: test appending a Series to a DataFrame using _append_internal with matching and mismatched column index types
test_concat_dtype_coercion: test that concat properly coerces dtypes when appending DataFrames with missing columns and different types
